businessModel: Freemium (discontinued); team acquired by Perplexity in May 2025
summary: Sidekick was a Chromium productivity browser with a sidebar of apps. Perplexity hired the team in May 2025, Sidekick shut down around August 2025, and its site now redirects to Comet.

faq.a: No; it was shut down around Aug 2025.
Perplexity launched Comet, which is a different product; alternatives include Dia, Arc, SigmaOS.
Sources conflict: one says Aug 3, 2025, another announced in Aug 2025 with refunds.

switching.note: Export bookmarks before they are lost; use alternatives.
